name: Forcing
overview: The topic of forcing, especially in the context of compelling someone against their will or sexually, is complex and must be understood in light of biblical truth. Matthew 11:12 highlights that the kingdom of heaven experiences opposition and force, yet this does not condone violence or coercion over others. Galatians 3:28 emphasizes the unity and equality of all believers in Christ, underscoring that no one should be dominated or compelled unjustly. Ultimately, salvation and righteousness come through faith and God’s grace, not through force or human effort, as Romans 3:20 and John 3:16 affirm.
